===Features=== :;WLAN *Dual-band 2.4GHz and 5GHz 802.11abgn/ac *High-speed wireless connection up to 433Mbps :transmit/receive PHY rate using 80MHz bandwidth *1x antenna to support 1x Transmit and :1x Receive technology and Bluetooth *WCS (Wireless Coexistence System) *Low power consumption and high performance :Enhanced wireless security *Fully speed operation with Piconet and Scatternet support *Form factor: M.2 LGA 1212 (soldered down) *Dimension: 12mm x 12mm x 1.65mm (LxWxH) :;Bluetooth *Fully qualified Bluetooth BT 4.2 *Compliant Bluetooth BT 5.0 *Enhanced Data Rate (EDR) compliant for :both 2Mbps and 3Mbps supported *High speed UART and PCM for Bluetooth <!-- ===Specifications=== :[[AzureWave AW-CM389NF]] {{•}} [https://storage.googleapis.com/wzukusers/user-26561200/documents/5b7d0fccd80bcEDRCVCF/AW-CM389NF-DS-Rev1.2.pdf Datasheet] *Wi-Fi: 802.11abgn/ac 2T2R MIMO (2.4/5GHz) :Antenna: 2x2 MIMO (Main: WLAN, Aux: WLAN/BT) *Interface: PCIe/USB 2.0/SDIO 3.0/UART/PCM/I2C/G-SPI :WLAN (PCIe/SDIO) • BT (USB/SDIO/UART) • NFC (x) *Bluetooth: BT 2.1 (EDR)/4.0 (HS)/4.2 (BLE) *NFC: Support removed - v1.2 (08/15/2016) *Quality of Service (QoS) support for multimedia *Drip-in WLAN Linux drivers on Android based systems *Support for Linux kernel versions up to 2.6.32 *Support for BlueZ v4.47 Bluetooth profiles *Form factor: M.2 LGA 1216 (soldered down) *Dimension: 12mm x 16mm x 1.8mm (LxWxH) -->
